xBRIEFInfo.description: Story xBRIEF for GitHub issue #2826 — treat successful empty open-issue refresh as cache-fresh.

plan.title: fix(preflight-cache): treat successful empty open-issue refresh as fresh

narratives.Description: After a successful open-only cache refresh that writes zero issues (empty inventory), verify:cache-fresh / preflight-cache still treat the cache as stale because minFetchedAt is null and age becomes Infinity. That blocks write hooks incorrectly. Fix evaluate.ts so a successfully refreshed empty open inventory is fresh while preserving fail-closed behavior for failed fetches, nonempty stale entries, drift, and --for-issue.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. In packages/core/src/preflight-cache/evaluate.ts, distinguish successful empty open-only refresh (inventory proven empty) from never-fetched/missing freshness metadata — likely via a durable refresh stamp or candidates-log/empty-populate signal written when issues_written=0 and failed=0. 2. Ensure age/staleness path does not use Infinityh as a hard block for that success case. 3. Add focused tests in evaluate.test.ts covering empty successful refresh => exit 0, and regression that failed/missing fetch still fails closed. 4. CHANGELOG [Unreleased].
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer with zero open issues, I want a successful empty open-issue refresh to count as fresh, so that write hooks are not blocked by Infinityh stale cache.
narratives.Overview: Observed on BestiMax with @deftai/directive v0.84.0: forced canonical open-only fetch returns issues_written=0 failed=0, then verify:cache-fresh shows minFetchedAt=null / Infinityh and blocks. Locus: packages/core/src/preflight-cache/evaluate.ts around minFetchedAt / ageMs Infinity.

items.title: Given a successful empty open-only refresh, when verify:cache-fresh runs, then it exits 0 as fresh.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a project whose open-issue fetch completed successfully with zero issues written and zero failures, when `task verify:cache-fresh` / preflight-cache evaluate runs without --for-issue, then it exits 0 and does not report Infinityh stale age as a blocking failure.

items.title: Given failed fetch or truly missing freshness metadata, when evaluate runs, then it still fails closed.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a failed open-only fetch, or a cache with no successful refresh stamp and no open entries, when evaluate runs, then it continues to fail closed (non-zero) and does not treat those cases as the successful-empty success path.

expected_outputs: successful empty open refresh treated as fresh
